name: Dylan's Aesop's Fables
subtitle: A fable a day, with its moral
description: One of Aesop's fables every day, the same one as on the wall: the whole story, with its picture and its moral.

Below it, all 338 of Aesop's fables, numbered: every fable of The Aesop for Children and of George Fyler Townsend's translation, each one once. Search them by title, moral or any word, and tap one to read it. Every fable has a picture: Milo Winter's from The Aesop for Children (1919), or one from an older edition (Bewick, Rackham, Tenniel, Caldecott, Crane, Dore).
